structured_output.summary: I added the two test names the reviewer said were missing. `TestStreamAccounting` in `metrics_test.go` and `TestStreamRegistry` in `streams_test.go` now exist. Each runs the existing scenario tests as subtests. No production code changed. The reverseproxy package passed with them; the other packages were not rerun.

criteria_notes.note: TestStreamAccounting (metrics_test.go) runs the counts-once and first-result-wins scenarios (8 concurrent finish calls, one counted). The TestUpgradedStreamAccounts* tests in streaming_test.go check the same through a real stream.

TestStreamRegistry (streams_test.go) covers live counting, add requiring a live upstream, closing only orphaned streams, first-error reporting and concurrency. Metrics accounting, Caddyfile parsing, and recorder/encode hijack safety are covered in metrics_test.go, caddyfile_test.go, responsewriter_test.go and encode_conformance_test.go.
Unchanged from the previous answer: the integration tests in stream_reload_test.go and intercept_test.go, the unit tests, and the adapt test reverse_proxy_stream_detached.caddyfiletest.
